title: Explainable machine learning differentiates necrotizing fasciitis and osteomyelitis via routine blood biomarkers.
summary: Routine blood markers distinguished two confirmed infections in a retrospective external cohort. The result is reported in the npj Digital Medicine. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: The selected LightGBM model integrated blood biomarkers and was evaluated in data from a geographically related external center.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Routine blood markers distinguished two confirmed infections in a retrospective external cohort.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established in the reviewed study.
